model.title: EMPOWER for Health Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. John Reed (D-RI)

summary.text: The bill would revise and extend federal health workforce programs that support training and education for doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals. It aims to strengthen the pipeline of medical professionals to address healthcare workforce shortages across the country.
